content: {"episode_id":"ep-05165","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for a patient who presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation, consistent with diagnosis codes I48.91 and I47.1. As documented in the clinical indication note, the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period support the order for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management. Authorization status is recorded as missing rather than reflecting any lack of medical necessity, and this documentation is submitted as the supporting clinical justification the payer letter requests."}
